caption: The drawing depicts a mannequin head mounted on a wooden stand. The mannequin head is light gray in color with black curly hair visible on one side beneath a white bonnet or headdress. The face of the mannequin is painted with distinct black eyebrows, large dark eyes, a straight nose, and red lips. The head is attached to a vertical wooden pole by a metal ring and wooden knob system, allowing for rotation or adjustment. The wooden pole extends down to a sturdy, cross-shaped wooden base that sits directly on the ground. The wood of the stand has a natural brown finish, showing the grain and texture. The entire object is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist's signature, "Beverly Chichester," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Hat Model
